1

Everyday charts

11 of 11 examples

Standard ggplot2 charts. Call use_phw_ggplot() once at the top of a script and every chart after it gets the PHW theme, font and colours. The scale functions pick colours from PHW palettes.

Back to top

Uncertainty and distributions

5 of 5 examples

Intervals you have already calculated, and the spread of values.

Back to top
3

Public health charts

4 of 4 examples

Ready-made charts for common surveillance and quality outputs. Each returns a ggplot, so you can add titles, scales or layers as usual.

Back to top
4

Extension packages

3 of 3 examples

ggplot2 extension packages are styled too. Load them before use_phw_ggplot(), or call phw_style_extensions() after loading them.

Layout and finishing

3 of 3 examples

Put several charts in one figure, add the source and date bar, and save at the right size.

Colour and accessibility

4 of 4 examples

Palettes, colour keys that keep each group's colour across reports, and checks for colour blindness and contrast.

Back to top
7

Maps

7 of 7 examples

Boundaries for every level of Welsh geography are downloaded on first use and cached. Static maps use ggplot2 and sf, and interactive maps use leaflet.

Back to top
8

Tables for reports

16 of 16 examples

flextable and gt tables for Word, PowerPoint, HTML and PDF. The summary functions turn a raw data frame into a finished table, and phw_flextable() and phw_gt() style it.

Back to top
9

Interactive tables and charts

9 of 9 examples

HTML widgets: sortable and searchable tables, and charts you can hover over and zoom. They show in the RStudio Viewer pane and in HTML outputs such as Quarto HTML reports, dashboards and Shiny apps. They can't go in Word or PDF.

Back to top
10

Reports and documents

9 of 9 examples

Templates for R Markdown and Quarto. Add the Quarto templates to a project with use_phw_quarto(). You find the R Markdown formats under File > New File > R Markdown > From Template.

Back to top
11

Slides, dashboards and apps

5 of 5 examples

Outputs for presenting and sharing live. Slides and dashboards are Quarto formats, and the Shiny theme works in any Shiny app.

Office files

2 of 2 examples

Tables and charts written to .xlsx and .pptx.
